title: Updates
scope: For this app on this device
latestDetail: Situate checks for updates in the background every 24 hours.
checkingDetail: You can keep working while Situate checks.
downloadDetail: The download continues while you work. Situate won’t restart on its own.
readyDetail: The update is downloaded. Install it whenever you’re ready to restart Situate.
installingDetail: Situate will reopen when installation is complete.
checkFailedDetail: A connection to the update service couldn’t be established. Check again later.

featureNotes.title: Fixes for navigation and document search
featureNotes.intro: Corrections to pane navigation and filtered document results.
featureNotes.imageUnavailable: This image is unavailable. You can still read the explanation below.

sections.title: Pane navigation
paragraphs: Fixed Back returning to the wrong note after following two references in the same pane.
details: This fix applies to multi-pane layouts on macOS. iOS navigation is unchanged.

sections.title: Document search
paragraphs: Fixed a cleared tag filter remaining active when you changed the search text.
sections.subheading: If a filter still appears active
details: Clear the search once and enter it again. Your documents and tags are unchanged.

0.8.0.title: Pane layouts and combined tag filters
0.8.0.intro: Keep related material in view and narrow a document search with multiple tags.
0.8.0.imageUnavailable: This image is unavailable. You can still read the explanation below.

sections.title: Keep a note beside its conversation
paragraphs: On macOS, split a tab into panes and resize them. Each pane keeps its own Back and Forward history.
details: Notes and conversations open one at a time; split-pane layouts are not available.

sections.title: Combine document tags
paragraphs: Select Any to match at least one chosen tag, or All to match every chosen tag.
details: Saved searches keep their current matching rule. Select All explicitly if you want to narrow an existing search.

0.7.2.title: Fixes for drafts and long filenames
0.7.2.intro: Corrections to retained conversation drafts and file list labels.
0.7.2.imageUnavailable: This image is unavailable. You can still read the explanation below.

sections.title: Conversation drafts
paragraphs: Fixed a draft disappearing from view when switching away from a conversation during a reply.
details: Open the conversation to continue editing its retained draft. Sending still requires your action.

sections.title: Long filenames on iOS
paragraphs: Fixed the file action button being pushed offscreen by long filenames.

0.7.1.title: Fixes for search and scrolling
0.7.1.imageUnavailable: This image is unavailable. You can still read the explanation below.

sections.title: Search text
paragraphs: Fixed pasted search text retaining leading spaces and hiding otherwise matching notes.
details: Fixed a note jumping to its beginning when returning from another tab on macOS.

0.7.0.title: Document tags
0.7.0.intro: Filter the document collection by a tag.
0.7.0.imageUnavailable: This image is unavailable. You can still read the explanation below.

sections.title: Filter by tag
paragraphs: Choose a tag in Documents to show matching material alongside your search results.
details: Refresh an existing document source once to include its tags. Tags are available only when the source supplies them.

restartIdle: Situate will save your work in all open windows, then restart with the update.
restartWorking: Actions are still running. Restarting will stop them and save your work in all open windows.
restartCaution: You can continue these chats with a new message after restarting.
forceWarning: Running actions will stop. Unsaved changes in any open window may be lost. Save anything you need before continuing.
preparingDetail: Stopping actions and saving work in all open windows. You can leave this page while Situate prepares to restart.
forcePreparingDetail: Stopping actions before restarting. You can leave this page while Situate prepares to restart.

preparationReasons.window: An open window couldn’t finish saving or confirm it was ready. Check your open windows and save your work, then try again.
preparationReasons.native: Running actions are still stopping. Wait for them to finish before trying again. The update will not restart Situate automatically.
preparationReasons.stop-failed: Situate couldn’t stop running actions safely. Wait for them to finish before trying again. A forced update cannot bypass this step.

manualInstallation: If this keeps happening, quit Situate once the actions finish and use a trusted installer of the same or a newer version. Keep your workspaces; don’t delete or reset them.
stoppedChats: Actions stopped for this attempt won’t restart on their own. Continue a chat with a new message.
unsynced: Some workspace changes haven’t synchronized yet.
syncDetail: The workspace stays open. Restart only continues after synchronization completes.

controls.title: Update simulation
controls.description: Synthetic releases and local interactions. No network, downloads, installation or application restart.
